description.en: Fades a screen back in from black with CMND_BLACK_FADE_IN and waits until CMND_IS_BLACK_FADE is false.
SCREEN_A (0, top), SCREEN_B (1, bottom) or SCREEN_AB (2, both).
Length of the fade in frames (EV_FADE_QUICK = 5, EV_FADE_NORMAL = 10, EV_FADE_SLOW = 15); 0 for an instant change.

examples.case: An instant change on both screens (real usage, e.g. ev42010100.nut)
